evidence.visual_basis: Downswing frames show hands moving outward away from body toward the ball — hands are farther from the torso than at address.
Hands clearly travel out away from chest as club moves toward the ball.
At delivery the clubhead is outside the hands and appears to be approaching across the ball (clubhead path shows outside-to-inside motion from DTL view).
Clubhead remains outside the hands and moves toward the torso/inside as it approaches impact, consistent with out-to-in approach.
Shaft in downswing appears noticeably steeper than the forearm beside it, with club above forearm on the inside plane.
Shaft remains upright relative to forearm as it approaches the ball, indicating a steeper delivery than the forearm.
Torso shows some reduction in forward tilt compared to address during the downswing — chest appears to rise slightly before impact.
Chest looks more upright than at setup while club is still approaching the ball.
